amp_note: amplitude ~ int8 / 127 * amp_clip (the base's 99th percentile); relative, compare within this file only

difference_rms_ratio.note: RMS of the difference over RMS of the base, in the quiet window (the grain) and below it

notes: amplitudes are relative; compare within this file only

the monitor is read at the base's traces, moved by +2.48 ms and scaled by 1.06, both measured over 600-1400 where nothing in the earth should have changed (median lag of 640 trace pairs; a constant offset between two processings is not a change in the earth)
the grain: after those corrections the two vintages still differ by an NRMS of 0.53 (correlation 0.92) in that window; a difference deeper down must be read against it

the engraving draws monitor minus base after the alignment: what both vintages share is erased, what the monitor adds or lacks remains; the same noise is in every part of it, so marks count only where they stand out from the grain above

Volve ST10010 PSDM full stack (3-41 degrees), depth-to-time converted, 4 ms; domain TIME and quantity AMPLITUDE as stated by the user from the text header; polarity unknown (not stated in the headers)
time-vs-depth check (seismic_lib): leans time; the cube is blank above about 196 ms (shallow mute), so its own seabed cannot be used
water bottom from the interpreters' horizons: 111 ms TWT and 91 m depth over the survey; read as time it implies 82 m of water, read as depth 111 m: only time fits
both volumes are PZ full-angle PSDM stacks converted to time, 4 ms, on the same grid; shot with different cable layouts and sources eight years apart
source_label: base ST0202, full stack, PSDM Kirchhoff, name ends _T; monitor ST10010, full stack, PSDM Kirchhoff, name ends _T
